answer: One enforceable rule: lock a compute bond for six epochs and slash it the moment two answers fingerprint-match. Near-duplicate embeddings collapse the farm into one cluster. Because it works by requiring post-paid stake that is forfeited on detection, cluster rewards are paid once, not per address. The basalt of work and the ledge of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a falcon to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
